points.description: Places the new data point among the existing classified (labelled) data and identifies its k nearest neighbours, forming a neighbourhood (the 'sphere') of k points. Equivalent wording such as 'find the k closest labelled points' earns the mark.

Assigns the new data to the class that receives the maximum vote among those k nearest neighbours (majority voting). Equivalent wording such as 'the most common class among the neighbours' earns the mark.
